question: 22|Looking at the green transition score of all the countries and regions over the years, what is the common patterns?
query: SELECT   year,   country_name,   green_transition_score FROM global_development_indicators WHERE green_transition_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year, country_name LIMIT 50;
